title: Student Transportation Services: Meal-Status Seat Waiver on Courtesy Permit Fees for Seats Accepted from the Waiting List
content:
Student Transportation Services applies the Calloway Creek ISD seat waiver under Board Policy FP(LOCAL) (TEC 11.158(b) fee waivers): the meal-status waiver credit on the permit fee of a seat accepted from the waiting list. The transportation office posts it against that permit fee on the day it is figured, as a free-meal waiver credit for a student holding any Free Meal Status tier and as a reduced-price meal waiver credit for a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier.

**Which fees.** For a permit fee posted later than its assignment's application date, which is the fee of a seat accepted from the waiting list, and only for such a fee, the meal-status waiver credit is the seat waiver of this rule. Every other permit fee keeps the rule that the fee, less the late application charge it carries, is waived by credit from the student's School Nutrition meal status on the posting date: a student holding any Free Meal Status tier is credited the free-meal waiver share of the fee table as a free-meal waiver credit, and a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier is credited the reduced-price waiver share as a reduced-price meal waiver credit; the waiver credit is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. This rule figures no seat waiver for a permit fee that is not the fee of a seat accepted from the waiting list: such a fee keeps that posting-date waiver, credited on its posting date, and nothing is owed for it under this rule.

**When it is figured.** The seat waiver is not figured until the permit fee for the accepted seat stands on the assignment's billing record.

A seat waiver that figures to zero is owed as nothing and posts no credit entry.

| Permit fee on the assignment | Meal-status waiver |
|---|---|
| posted later than the assignment's application date (a seat accepted from the waiting list) | the seat waiver, posted on the day it is figured |
| posted on the application date | the posting-date waiver, credited on its posting date; no seat waiver |

## Invocation: `post_waiver_credit_eb03a46e`

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `post_waiver_credit_eb03a46e` and then calls it. One call books one meal-status waiver credit against the courtesy rider permit fee of one student transportation assignment, linked to the permit fee and dated the day it is posted; the household's amount due on the assignment goes down by the credit and nothing else on the assignment changes.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `transport_assignment_id` | the reference number of the student's transportation assignment whose permit fee is waived, as returned by the transportation assignment lookup | identifier |
| `permit_fee_entry_id` | the reference number of the courtesy rider permit fee entry being waived, exactly as shown on that fee in the assignment's billing history lookup; it must be a permit fee entry of the same assignment | identifier |
| `waiver_level` | the meal benefit level the waiver rests on, which sets the credit's waiver reason | `free` (the student holds a Free Meal Status tier; reason free meal waiver) or `reduced` (the student holds a Reduced-Price Meal Status tier; reason reduced-price meal waiver) |
| `waiver_amount` | the waiver credited against the permit fee, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; recorded exactly as given |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new credit entry's reference number (an opaque id beginning `tlw_`), the assignment reference number, the permit fee entry it is linked to, the waiver reason (`free_meal_waiver` or `reduced_meal_waiver`), the credited amount in US dollars with two decimals and the posting date (YYYY-MM-DD).

**Errors.** A message beginning "Error:" means nothing was posted: the waiver level is not `free` or `reduced`; the amount is not a positive amount with at most two decimal places; or the permit fee entry given is not a permit fee entry of the named assignment.
